purpose: Prove one nonzero canonical Order Benefit from immutable application and line allocation through exact economic funding, net-payment transport, Outbox CDC, and lakehouse reconciliation; benefit reversal is intentionally a separate gate.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only

inputs.canonical_sku: ACTIVE in the same-tenant canonical Catalog
inputs.benefit: one PROMOTION application allocated to line-1

flow: place one order with an explicit line key and a nonzero governed benefit application
persist immutable application, allocation, and two funding shares in the order transaction
reserve 2 and capture/refund the exact net payable amount of 36000 minor units
ship and complete, then retain the legacy direct refund/return tail only as net-payment and inventory transport regression evidence
replay every command and require immutable duplicate results
wait for Outbox CDC and reconcile the exact run with reconcile-canonical-order-benefit
invariants: header discount equals application, allocation, funding, and item discount totals
gross amount equals item discount plus net amount
the calculation digest is deterministic SHA-256 over governed economic input
the two funding shares retain explicit funder type and identity
zero event or readiness rows fail the reconciliation gate
every write replays as an immutable duplicate
this scenario does not claim benefit, funding, or AfterSale reversal
cleanup: none; retain the run-scoped order, benefits, payment, inventory, Outbox, CDC, and lakehouse evidence
